# Issue 管理

[中文](README.zh.md)

This directory is the English entry for maintainers. The working copy is [README.zh.md](README.zh.md). Sagebeast adapts DeepSeek Harness issue-management capabilities to a single-maintainer repository: templates, label taxonomy, trusted pull-request policy, and label-backed lifecycle. It does not copy Project App tokens, weighted review, or release workflows.
